theorem normalized_velocity_ray_bound (upper : ℝ) (B : ℕ) {X : ℝ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hXhi : X ≤ FinalSlowBase.boxRadius W upper) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 →
      |τ ^ CoordinateAlgebra.A F.data.h *
        FinalSlowBase.velocity H v upper B (1 - τ, ray X τ) 1 - leadingAmplitude v X| ≤
        C * τ ^ (2 * F.data.h)
